meta.title: Dark stores across India's top 10 cities (CLSA mapping)
meta.unit: dark stores in the top 10 cities combined (not national totals)
meta.note: This is the only like-for-like store comparison across all five players. National totals differ (e.g. Blinkit has 2,443 stores nationally). CLSA also reported Blinkit has the most stores in 6 of the 10 cities and Zepto leads in the other 4, and that Flipkart Minutes moved ahead of Instamart on both store count and pincode coverage.
